title: Agent transcripts, MCP results and git output
summary: Twenty locally authored payloads: chat transcripts between a user and an agent, MCP tool results, and git log and diff output, including environment-style examples, with no credential.
rationale: Agent and tool payloads are a fast-growing source of text that contains structured JSON, commit hashes, session ids and example environment variables, and they are scanned in flight.
unscopedReason: Authored detector and arrival-target metadata intentionally assign no credential family; this fixture remains a global benchmark control.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. Authored so that any environment-style example uses a placeholder and every long value is a hash or an id.

incidents.summary: generic-token redacts secret-reference names and identifiers in ordinary config/source (untargeted real-world-shapes)

externalRefs.note: Product issue where the failure mode was reported; product workflow status is not imported.
